chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Ali ibn Khalid, from the one who narrated it, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
My father used to say: 'The one entering the Ka'bah enters, and Allah is Pleased with him, and he exits having been neutralized from the sins.'

key_terms.الْكَعْبَةَ: The Ka'bah, the cubic structure in Mecca central to Islamic pilgrimage and prayer.
key_terms.رَاضٍ: Pleased, satisfied, or well-pleased (referring to Allah's pleasure).
key_terms.عُطَلًا: Neutralized, cleared, or discharged (referring to sins being forgiven or removed).

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of entering the Ka'bah according to Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) narrates that his father, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him), taught that entering the Ka'bah with devotion brings Allah's pleasure and results in the forgiveness or neutralization of sins. This hadith highlights the Ka'bah not merely as a physical structure but as a spiritual locus of divine acceptance, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on the sanctity of the House of Allah as a means of attaining *ridwan* (divine pleasure). The phrase 'uljan min al-dhunub' suggests a comprehensive cleansing, linking the physical act of pilgrimage to spiritual purification.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Amro Bin Usman, from Ali Bin Khalid, from the one who narrated it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Amro Bin Usman, from Ali Bin Khalid, from the one who narrated it, from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘
The one entering the Kabah enters, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is Pleased from him, and he returns having been neutralised from the sins’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from ‘Amr ibn ‘Uthman from Ali ibn Khalid from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
My father would say, ‘One who enters al-Ka‘bah does so while Allah is happy with him and comes out while his sins are suspended.’”
